correctness.rationale: For general P^7 inside P(∧²C^8), the rank<=4 Pfaffian locus has codimension six, rank<=2 locus codimension fifteen, so the intersection C is a general smooth curve avoiding rank-two points; the Jacobian scheme is reduced by transverse normal form q=z12*z34-z13*z24+z14*z23. The projective bundle over Gr(4,8) resolving rank<=4 has canonical -6xi-5c1(Q), and C is a complete intersection of twenty xi divisors. Along rank four, symplectic Pfaffian trivialization c1(Q)=2xi yields K_C=4xi. Exact Grassmannian Schubert integral ∫h16(pair sums)=84 gives deg C=84, genus 1+2*84=169; six-normal-variable nondegenerate quadratic has Milnor fibre S^5, leading to Euler defect 2g-2=336. Smooth quartic sixfold has Euler 1648, so singular has 1312. Independent *equivariant localization*, different from source coefficient-extraction routine, recomputed 84,168,24024 and Euler values.
